comment: Bought my 2021 Hyundai Creta from JP CARS. Very honest disclosure about previous owner and service history. RC transfer was handled smoothly in just 10 days.
Best pre-owned car dealer in Kallakurichi region. The vehicle condition is exactly as shown on the website. No hidden charges or commission surprises.
Sold my old Swift and bought an Innova Crysta. Got the highest evaluation price compared to online portals. Very polite and professional staff.
Finance process was fast through Cholamandalam Finance arranged by JP CARS. Received car delivery on auspicious day with full tank and detailed wash.
